subject: FAD productization — kickoff and Q2 milestones
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off our productization of Frechet Audio Distance (FAD). The pitch: FAD is a reference-free evaluation metric for audio generation, particularly music enhancement, so we can score enhancement models without paired ground truth. I want this wrapped as a portfolio-standard metric service that every speech-audio launch review can cite.

Proposed milestones inside the Q2 window: port the Beam scoring pipeline by Apr 17, validate FAD against our internal listening-test panels by May 8, and take the metric service to Launch Review Board on May 22 (I have pinged Nadia to hold a slot).

Team: Hyun, Gustavo and Maren are the assigned contributors; Santiago owns feasibility. Can you come back with staffing fractions and compute asks by end of next week?

Thanks,
Goran
